## Fox-hunting, decoupled watching, and a screen that got a lot more useful

The watch feature from last release could tell you a device was nearby, but not where it was. HUNT MODE fixes that — long-press a device in the raw-scan results (or now the LOG screen too) and pick HUNT instead of WATCH to drop into a live signal-strength gauge: a needle sweeping weak-to-strong as you move, plus a warmer/colder trend readout. Worth saying plainly: neither board has a magnetometer, so this isn't a self-orienting compass — it's a strength meter you sweep by hand, the same way real fox-hunting works with a plain receiver. Rotate your body to find where the signal fades, walk toward where it doesn't.

WATCH and HUNT are now fully independent targets — picking one no longer silently cancels the other, so a passive watch can keep running in the background while you actively hunt something else entirely.

The long-press-to-track menu isn't exclusive to the raw scanner anymore either — it's on the LOG screen now too, so anything already logged can be watched or hunted without re-finding it in a fresh scan. (One bug surfaced and got fixed before it ever shipped: the confirm panel wasn't actually rendering on LOG, so a long-press there would silently swallow every subsequent tap until you backed all the way out.)

Also in this release: an on-device diagnostics screen for checking touch/heap/calibration state without a serial monitor, a visual overhaul of the Settings screen (grouped, color-coded, a dimmed version of your chosen background running behind it), a fix for touch scrolling registering as accidental taps, a much deeper detection log, and a rotation-lock option for anyone tired of an accidental title-bar tap flipping their orientation mid-scan.

### The actually-useful part
- **Added**: HUNT MODE — a live signal-strength gauge for a watched target, reached via long-press → HUNT on any raw-scan result or LOG entry
- **Added**: long-press-to-track (WATCH/HUNT) is now available on the LOG screen, not just the raw scanner
- **Changed**: WATCH and HUNT targets are now independent — setting one no longer overwrites the other
- **Added**: signal-strength history for the watched target, shown as a trend line on the watch-alert screen
- **Added**: on-device DIAGNOSTICS screen (Settings) — touch/calibration/heap/reset-reason readout, no serial monitor needed
- **Changed**: detection log capacity increased from 32 to 200 entries
- **Changed**: Settings screen redesigned — grouped by category with color coding, bigger font, a scrollbar, and a dimmed version of the active background running behind it
- **Added**: ROTATION LOCK setting to disable the title-bar rotate button
- **Fixed**: touch scroll on LOG/raw-scan/Settings registering as an accidental tap on the row underneath
- **Fixed**: LOG's new long-press confirm panel wasn't rendering, silently blocking all touch on that screen until backed out
